title: Work great
text: Work great. I use these hooks for everything. They are great. Mostly I have used them to hang and dry herbs from my garden for the winter. They worked out perfectly. I have also used them to hang item on the inside of my cabinet doors, which gives me more space usage.

product_metadata.title: Command 17067-VP Value Pack Small Wire, 9 Hooks, White, 9 Count
features: HOLDS UP TO 0.5 POUNDS: One package of the Command White Small Wire Toggle Hooks includes 9 wall hooks and 12 adhesive strips and a metal wire toggle feature for versatile hanging; each adhesive wall hook can hold up to 0.5 pounds
DAMAGE FREE HANGING: Wall hooks work without leaving holes, marks or sticky residue so you can move and rehang hats, calendars, keys, measuring spools, cleaning tools, jewelry and accessories

WORKS ON A VARIETY OF SMOOTH SURFACES: Adhesive wall hangers work on a variety of smooth surfaces, including painted walls, finished wood, painted concrete cinder blocks, laminate, glass, metal and tiles

SURFACE PREP: Clean with rubbing alcohol to remove grime and dust to allow the hanging hooks to bond to the surface; the indoor temperature must be between 50 degrees Fahrenheit and 105 degrees Fahrenheit
USAGE TIPS: Wait seven days after painting before using the Command Hooks to allow paint to cure; do not hang over beds or on wallpaper; do not use the wall hooks for hanging valuable items

EASY CLEAN REMOVAL: Lightly hold the top of the wall adhesive strips and slowly pull straight down towards the floor to remove the 3M Hooks and prevent damage of walls and surfaces; reuse your hook and hardware again by purchasing small refill strips
description: Command White Small Wire Hooks let you decorate and organize how you want, when you want, without damaging surfaces. A great home improvement item, these no damage wall hooks stick on a variety of smooth surfaces without leaving holes, marks or sticky residue. Use these hanging hooks to hang hats, calendars, keys, measuring spools, cleaning tools, jewelry and other small items. Simply mount these indoor wall adhesive hooks on painted walls, finished wood, painted concrete cinder blocks, laminate, glass, metal and tiles and enjoy the damage free hanging of your favorite small decorations and organizers. Perfect for home renovators and college students, use these wall hooks for hanging decorations and organizers in your home, office, apartment or dorm room to elevate the appearance of your living or working space without tools. Directions are included; follow the directions closely to use the wall hangers as intended. A clever decorating and organizing solution that doesn’t damage surfaces, these small wire tool free wall hangers will help you fearlessly change your space. One package contains 9 white wire toggle hooks and 12 small adhesive strips. Each single wall hanger can hold up to 0.5 pounds. Decorate, organize and celebrate damage free with Command.
